**Tier 5** — results — pinned to dataset + policy + engine version · owned by `engine` · `public.simulation_performance_metrics`

**One row is** One telemetry record for one legacy job: how long the RETIRED `ml-service` took, what memory and CPU it used, how many iterations it needed and how many service calls and database queries it made. Operational measurements of a run, not results of the simulated supply chain. Tier 5 — input to nothing. DORMANT IN THE REPOSITORY: no code in `src/`, `supabase/functions/`, `sim-worker/` or `scsim/` reads or writes it; its only writer was the `ml-service`, whose source left this repository with the legacy stack.

A RETIRED PIPELINE'S TELEMETRY, LEFT IN PLACE ON PURPOSE by the 2026-07-02 commit that removed the legacy batch stack. A drop needs a production row count first, which no §15 run has taken. Every measure below was whatever the `ml-service` chose to report — its writer spread a metrics dict straight into the insert — so no column has a definition this repository can still check.

## Governance

| | |
|---|---|
| Read capability | any project member |
| Write capability | **no user-facing write path** |
| Minimum project role | `viewer` |
| Tier transitions audited | **no** — invariant `audit-actor` is not met here yet |
| Row-level security | enabled |
| Policies on the table | 2 — all carry a predicate |

Two policies through the project's organization (`org_is_current_user_org(p.organization_id, p.organization)`): SELECT for any member of that organization, ALL for the project's modeler or an organization admin. Neither is predicate-less, so `write: null` agrees with `governanceEnforcement.test.ts`, and no user-facing write path exists in the repository. Deleting a project, or a legacy job, removes these rows through the inline `REFERENCES … ON DELETE CASCADE` on `project_id` and `simulation_job_id`. The `ml-service` that wrote it ran on Render, outside this repository and outside D168's function list; the 2026-07-02 removal commit asks for that service to be deleted by hand, and the repository does not record whether it was. §4 D168 does list `delete-simulation-job` — which deleted these rows — among the legacy edge functions still LIVE in production with no source here. NOT AUDITED: tier 5, and `audit-actor` covers tiers 2–4.

## Columns

`CSV header` is the name the **user types**, which is not always the column name —
that gap is defect D21. A dash means the column has no CSV origin.

| Column | CSV header | Type | Unit | Required in CSV | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `id` 🔑 | — | `uuid` | — | — | Surrogate key. One row per report; nothing enforces one per job. |
| `simulation_job_id` | — | `uuid` | — | — | The `simulation_jobs.id` the measurements describe. `REFERENCES simulation_jobs ON DELETE CASCADE`, inline. |
| `project_id` | — | `uuid` | — | — | The owning project, looked up from the job by the writer. `REFERENCES projects ON DELETE CASCADE`, inline. |
| `execution_time_seconds` | — | `numeric` | `second` | — | Wall-clock time the legacy run took, as the service measured it. |
| `memory_usage_mb` | — | `numeric` | `megabytes` | — | Memory the legacy run used, as the service reported it. |
| `cpu_usage_percent` | — | `numeric` | `percent` | — | CPU utilisation during the legacy run, as the service reported it. |
| `data_processing_time_seconds` | — | `numeric` | `second` | — | The part of the run spent loading and preparing project data. |
| `cache_hit_ratio` | — | `numeric` | — | — | Share of the run's lookups served from `simulation_cache`, as the service reported it. Dimensionless; whether it was stated as a fraction or a percentage was the service's choice and is not recoverable. |
| `convergence_iterations` | — | `integer` | — | — | How many iterations the legacy engine took to meet its convergence threshold. |
| `accuracy_score` | — | `numeric` | — | — | A quality score the legacy service attached to its own run. Its definition lived in that service and is not in this repository, so the number cannot be interpreted — it is NOT a validation result (that is `model_validations`). |
| `python_service_calls` | — | `integer` | — | — | How many calls the run made to the Python service. DEFAULT 0. |
| `database_queries` | — | `integer` | — | — | How many database queries the run issued. DEFAULT 0. |
| `created_at` | — | `timestamp with time zone` | — | — | When the row was inserted. |
| `organization` | — | `text` | — | — | The organization's NAME at write time, DEFAULT 'default_org'. Legacy tenancy text; the policies read the project's organization instead. |
